mappings.requirement: AC1: sign in with valid credentials → Projects page with the list; invalid → error on /login.
AC2: create a project with a unique name → success toast, project in list.
unit_tests: project creation / naming: uniqueness check accepts a non-matching name
mappings.note: Happy path only in this AC; the negative (duplicate) path is AC3.

mappings.requirement: AC3: duplicate name → error toast, list unchanged.
unit_tests: project creation / naming: uniqueness check rejects a matching name
project creation / naming: duplicate rejection returns the specific error
mappings.note: No boundary case (e.g. case-sensitivity of the uniqueness check) — spec doesn't define one; flagged in the unit checklist for the team to confirm.

mappings.requirement: AC4: delete from the row after confirming → project gone from list.
AC5: search box filters rows by name fragment.
unit_tests: search / filtering: empty fragment returns unfiltered list
search / filtering: zero matches renders empty without erroring
mappings.note: Boundary case (case-sensitivity of the filter) undefined by spec; flagged in the unit checklist.

mappings.requirement: AC6: zero projects → "No projects yet", no table.
unit_tests: empty state: zero-projects message + no table

test_gaps: AC2/AC3: no defined case-sensitivity rule for name uniqueness — needs a product decision before a boundary test can be written.
AC5: no defined case-sensitivity rule for search matching, and no spec'd behavior for zero search *results* (as opposed to zero total projects) — needs a product decision.

playwright/tests/projects.spec.ts is currently non-functional: TC-03's assertion is vacuous and both TC-03/TC-04 import pom/api modules that don't exist in the repo, with no playwright.config or package.json present either. Automation for all 9 test cases needs to be built via /qa-e2e-setup + /qa-e2e-pom + /qa-e2e-write.
